mapper.select: SELECT reorg_key, reorg_dt FROM hrm_org_reorg WHERE conf_yn = 'Y' AND use_yn = 'Y' AND reorg_dt <= CURRENT_DATE AND reorg_key = #{reorgKey} ORDER BY reorg_dt DESC, reg_dtm DESC, reorg_key LIMIT 1
SELECT dept_key, parent_dept_key, dept_cd, dept_nm FROM hrm_org_dept WHERE reorg_key = #{reorgKey} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY dept_level, sort_order, dept_cd, dept_key
SELECT code, code_name AS name FROM com_code WHERE parent_code = #{parentCode} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_order, code

SELECT p.person_key, p.employee_no, p.name_ko, p.dept_cd, d.dept_nm AS dept_name, p.grade_code, grade.code_name AS grade_name, p.position_code, position.code_name AS position_name, p.service_status_code, status.code_name AS service_status_name
ORDER BY
p.name_ko d.dept_nm grade.code_name position.code_name status.code_name p.employee_no
DESCASC NULLS LAST, p.employee_no ASC, p.person_key ASC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{query.offset}
